text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agency) Notification 2014 and shall come into operation on 7 October 2014.
2. The Singapore Tourism Board is prescribed as a law enforcement agency for the purposes of section 112(1)(c) of the Code.
